facts.text: Jolene's pendant has a symbol that represents freedom and serves as a reminder to pursue her goals.

evidence.quote: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.

facts.text: Jolene's pendant was given to her by her mother in Paris in 2010.

evidence.quote: This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010 in Paris.
